top_signal.title: Apps to manage multiple small businesses projects and needs?
top_signal.summary: Hello guys,   I run 3 small business, with 2 employees each and I've used microsoft to do for daily tasks. I'm struggling beacause I don't have a project view, to have notes and to schedulled what's needed to complete that specified project. If I didn't finish a specific task it goes to the past events so after a year or two, I have a lot of task that I haven't done and it's a mess. Sometimes I lost the way and don't see what's missing, and what's to be done.   So how do you guys keep track on what you need to do next to run your business?   I really like to work with the mobile phose, as I'm always runing between those 3 business.   Give me your suggestions please.       submitted by     /u/BrummBrumm7       [link]       [comments]
